name: University of Freiburg - University College Freiburg
summary: The University of Freiburg's English-taught college: one four-year Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor, about 80 places a year, with four majors.

ib.text: Ranked on your IB converted to a German grade, improved by up to 0.5 each for a 500-word essay and a 500-word motivation letter. English at B2; Freiburg itself must recognise your IB (KMK rule).

programmes.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
programmes.about: A four-year, English-taught liberal arts degree: a shared foundational year of academic skills and three subject introductions, then one of four majors; about 80% of students spend a term abroad, usually in year three.
programmes.ib: Majors: Culture and History, Governance, Life Sciences, or Environmental and Sustainability Sciences. Essay, motivation letter and proof of the LAS online study-choice assistant.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Converted IB grade, improved by up to 0.5 each for letter and essay (each 4.0+); 90% of places this way, 10% by waiting time.

notes: The 2027 dates are not out yet: for 2026 the window ran 1 June to 15 July, and the essay topic and letter guidelines are published on 1 April each year.
Freiburg's English B2 list names an IB only from an anglophone country, so ask UCF whether yours counts or take IELTS (5.5+) or TOEFL iBT (72+).
You register on hochschulstart first; if you apply elsewhere through it too, set your priorities by the DoSV cut-off (22 July in 2026).
